title: Inverse sign pair vector coordinates
statement: For every natural number $n$, every pair $x,y$ of sign-valued vectors on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and every coordinate $i$, the inverse of the coordinatewise pairing equivalence sends $(x,y)$ to the vector whose $i$th entry is $(x_i,y_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ and $y$ are sign-valued vectors of length $n$
$i$ is a coordinate in the length-$n$ index set
